children.name: Coracina
children.description: The larger cuckooshrikes — a widespread genus of medium to large passerines found from Africa through Asia to Australasia, with grey, black, and white plumage and stout, slightly hooked bills. Despite their name, they are neither cuckoos nor shrikes, but an independent family of arboreal insectivores. Many species are highly vocal with loud, fluty, far-carrying calls.

children.name: Coracina macei
children.description: The Indian cuckooshrike (Coracina macei) is a species of bird in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae that is found on the Indian subcontinent.

children.name: Coracina bicolor
children.description: The pied cuckooshrike (Coracina bicolor) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina larvata
children.description: The Sunda cuckooshrike (Coracina larvata) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina longicauda
children.description: The hooded cuckooshrike (Coracina longicauda) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina lineata
children.description: The barred cuckooshrike (Coracina lineata), also called the yellow-eyed cuckooshrike, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina schistacea
children.description: The slaty cuckooshrike (Coracina schistacea) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina atriceps
children.description: The Moluccan cuckooshrike (Coracina atriceps) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina caesia
children.description: The grey cuckooshrike (Ceblepyris caesius) is a species of bird in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina cinerea
children.description: The Madagascar cuckooshrike (Ceblepyris cinereus), also known as the ashy cuckooshrike, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina coerulescens
children.description: The blackish cuckooshrike (Edolisoma coerulescens) or the blackish cicadabird or Luzon graybird, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina personata
children.description: The Wallacean cuckooshrike (Coracina personata) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina fortis
children.description: The Buru cuckooshrike (Coracina fortis) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina temminckii
children.description: The cerulean cuckooshrike (Coracina temminckii) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina dobsoni
children.description: The Andaman cuckooshrike (Coracina dobsoni) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Coracina nebulosa
children.description: A small, green and yellow bird with intricate markings, known for its unique song that mimics other local species.

children.name: Ceblepyris albiceps
children.description: A rare and striking bird with a pale, almost translucent plumage that stands out among its peers in the savanna.

children.name: Lobotos rubescens
children.description: A medium-sized bird with a rust-colored breast and dark wings, known for its loud, repetitive calls that can be heard throughout the day.

children.name: Pteropodocys fasciatus
children.description: A striking bird with a distinctive black and white pattern on its wings, known for its swift flight and melodious song.

children.name: Campochaera flava
children.description: A vibrant yellow bird with a black crown and white throat, known for its cheerful song that fills the air in the early mornings.

children.name: Cyanograucalus cyanogriseus
children.description: A strikingly colored bird with a blue head, grey body, and vibrant orange accents on its wings, known for its distinctive call that echoes through the open plains.

children.name: Edolisoma aurantiacum
children.description: A brightly colored bird with a striking orange head and body, known for its loud call that is often heard during the breeding season.

children.name: Lalage melanogrisea
children.description: A medium-sized bird with a grey chest and black wings, known for its distinctive call that is often heard in coastal regions.

children.name: Pericrocotus melanopus
children.description: A strikingly colored bird with a black wing pattern, known for its melodious song that is often heard in dense forests.

children.name: Pericrocotus flavipes
children.description: A bird with a yellowish foot, known for its loud calls and striking patterns that make it stand out in the forest.

children.name: Pericrocotus rufipes
children.description: A bird with vibrant red feet, known for its melodious call that is often heard in the early morning.

children.name: Pericrocotus nigripes
children.description: A bird with a distinctive black neck, known for its loud and distinctive call that can be heard across the region.

children.name: Celebesica
children.description: A monotypic genus of cuckooshrike endemic to the island of Sulawesi. The single species has a distinctive crest and was formerly placed in Coracina before being moved to its own genus.

children.name: Celebesica abbotti
children.description: The pygmy cuckooshrike (Celebesica abbotti) is a species of bird in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae.

children.name: Ceblepyris
children.description: A genus of grey cuckooshrikes found in sub-Saharan Africa and Madagascar. They have relatively plain grey plumage and are often inconspicuous in the forest canopy.

children.name: Ceblepyris cinereifrons
children.description: A small, grey cuckooshrike with a pale grey forehead, endemic to the island of Mindanao in the Philippines. It inhabits lowland and montane forests and is classified as Near Threatened due to habitat loss.

children.name: Lobotos
children.description: The wattled cuckooshrikes — a distinctive genus of African cuckooshrikes with brightly coloured facial wattles. They are among the most colourful members of the Campephagidae, with males showing striking orange, yellow, or red bare skin around the eyes.

children.name: Pteropodocys
children.description: A monotypic genus of large, terrestrial cuckooshrike found across Australia and New Guinea. Unlike other cuckooshrikes, it forages primarily on the ground, running swiftly with a distinctive gait. Its elongated legs and terrestrial habits make it unique among the Campephagidae.

children.name: Pteropodocys maxima
children.description: The ground cuckoo-shrike (Coracina maxima) is an uncommon bird species endemic to Australia, occurring mainly in open woodland and arid grasslands throughout inland Australia, but also occasionally in areas on the east coast.

children.name: Campochaera
children.description: A genus of brightly coloured cuckooshrikes with striking golden-yellow or orange underparts, restricted to New Guinea. They are among the most colourful members of the Campephagidae and inhabit lowland rainforests where they forage in the canopy.

children.name: Campochaera sloetii
children.description: The golden cuckooshrike (Campochaera sloetii) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Cyanograucalus
children.description: A monotypic genus of blue-plumaged cuckooshrike found in the rainforests of West and Central Africa. The single species is notable for its brilliant azure-blue upperparts, which are unique among the otherwise grey, black, and white cuckooshrikes.

children.name: Cyanograucalus azureus
children.description: The blue cuckooshrike (Cyanograucalus azureus) is a species of bird in the Cuckooshrike family, Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma
children.description: The cicadabirds — a genus of cuckooshrikes named for their cicada-like songs. They are found from Southeast Asia through New Guinea to the southwest Pacific, with mostly grey or black-and-white plumage. Many species show striking sexual dimorphism.

children.name: Edolisoma dispar
children.description: The Kai cicadabird (Edolisoma dispar) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma ceramense
children.description: The pale cicadabird (Edolisoma ceramense) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma tenuirostre
children.description: The Sahul cicadabird (Edolisoma tenuirostre), previously known as the common cicadabird or slender-billed cicadabird, is a species of passerine bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma morio
children.description: The Sulawesi cicadabird (Edolisoma morio) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma melas
children.description: The black cicadabird (Edolisoma melas), also known as the New Guinea cuckooshrike or New Guinea cicadabird, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma salvadorii
children.description: The Sangihe cicadabird (Edolisoma salvadorii) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is endemic to the island of Sangir, also written as "Sangihe", and the Talaud Islands.

children.name: Edolisoma holopolium
children.description: The Solomons cicadabird (Edolisoma holopolium), also known as Solomons cuckooshrike and black-bellied cicadabird, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma monacha
children.description: The Palau cicadabird (Edolisoma monacha) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma insipidum
children.description: A plain grey cicadabird found in the lowland forests of New Guinea and the Bismarck Archipelago. Its song is a thin, insect-like trill.

children.name: Edolisoma remotum
children.description: The Bismarck cicadabird (Edolisoma remotum) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Edolisoma nehrkorni
children.description: A small cicadabird endemic to the island of Waigeo off the coast of New Guinea. It inhabits lowland forests and is poorly known.

children.name: Edolisoma parkinsoni
children.description: A cicadabird found in the lowland forests of the Bismarck Archipelago and the Solomon Islands.

children.name: Edolisoma timoriense
children.description: The Timor cicadabird (Edolisoma timoriense) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found on the islands of Lembata, Alor and Timor in Indonesia.

children.name: Edolisoma obiense
children.description: The Obi cicadabird (Edolisoma obiense) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found the island of Obi in the Maluku Islands (or Moluccas) in Indonesia.

children.name: Edolisoma sulaense
children.description: A small cicadabird endemic to the Sula Islands of the Moluccas, inhabiting lowland forests.

children.name: Lalage
children.description: The trillers and smaller cuckooshrikes — a genus of elegant, slender passerines with black, white, and grey plumage patterns, named for the male's distinctive reeling trilling call. They are more active and acrobatic than the larger Coracina cuckooshrikes, often flicking their wings rapidly. Found across Africa, Asia, Australia, and the Pacific islands.

children.name: Lalage poliocephala
children.description: A small, grey-headed cuckooshrike with a white belly and distinctive white wing-bars, endemic to the Philippine islands. It inhabits forests, forest edges, and secondary growth from lowlands to mid-elevations.

children.name: Lalage leucomela
children.description: The varied triller (Lalage leucomela) like its better-known relative the white-winged triller, is a smaller member of the cuckoo-shrike family, Campephagidae.

children.name: Lalage maculosa
children.description: The Polynesian triller (Lalage maculosa) is a passerine bird belonging to the triller genus Lalage in the cuckoo-shrike family Campephagidae.

children.name: Lalage sharpei
children.description: The Samoan triller (Lalage sharpei), known in Samoan as miti tae, is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Lalage nigra
children.description: The pied triller (Lalage nigra) is a species of bird in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae.

children.name: Lalage fagei
children.description: A medium-sized triller with a black crown, grey upperparts, and pale underparts, found in the Bismarck Archipelago. It inhabits lowland forests.

children.name: Lalage typica
children.description: The Mauritius cuckooshrike (Lalage typica) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus
children.description: The minivets — a strikingly colourful genus of small passerines in the cuckooshrike family, with brilliant red, orange, or yellow underparts contrasting with black or grey upperparts. They are among the most brightly coloured of all Asian songbirds and are often seen in fast-moving flocks that sweep through the forest canopy in search of insects.

children.name: Pericrocotus speciosus
children.description: The scarlet minivet (Pericrocotus speciosus) is a small passerine bird in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus divaricatus
children.description: The ashy minivet (Pericrocotus divaricatus) is a passerine bird of eastern Asia belonging to the minivet genus Pericrocotus in the cuckooshrike family Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus roseus
children.description: The rosy minivet (Pericrocotus roseus) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus cinnamomeus
children.description: The small minivet (Pericrocotus cinnamomeus) is a small passerine bird.

children.name: Pericrocotus igneus
children.description: The fiery minivet (Pericrocotus igneus) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus flammeus
children.description: The orange minivet (Pericrocotus flammeus) is a brightly colored bird in the cuckooshrike family, Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus miniatus
children.description: The Sunda minivet (Pericrocotus miniatus) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.

children.name: Pericrocotus leucophaeus
children.description: A pale grey minivet with a white throat and red or yellow patches on the wings and tail, found from the Himalayas to Southeast Asia. It inhabits forests and woodlands.

children.name: Pericrocotus tegimae
children.description: The Ryukyu minivet (Pericrocotus tegimae) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae.
